title: Hackers Exploit Qubole's Trusted AWS Access to Breach Customer Accounts and Steal Data
hint: An attacker broke into AWS accounts belonging to multiple Qubole customers between October 14 and October 26 and stole stored secrets and data, cloud security company Wiz said today.
